approaches.title: Attractive coupling and linear drift
approaches.mechanism: Poisson graphical coupling; positive-vector generator drift; nonnegative resolvent
approaches.retained_result: Complete finite/general subcritical lemmas, not a general sharpness proof
approaches.remaining_gap: Cannot reverse a linear upper bound or conclude a supercritical lower tail.

approaches.title: Exact complete-graph asymptotics
approaches.mechanism: Birth-death stationary weights; uniform logarithmic asymptotics; unique maximizer
approaches.retained_result: Complete restricted-family threshold theorem, including critical case; fast-vanishing immigration counterexample to stronger quantifiers
approaches.remaining_gap: No lumpable scalar count process on arbitrary networks.

approaches.title: Heterogeneous connected construction
approaches.mechanism: Weak-arrow domination; clique/dimer block squeezing; exact spectral norm bounds
approaches.retained_result: Complete counterexample to spectral-threshold equivalence under valid endpoint assumptions; not a counterexample to the conjecture
approaches.remaining_gap: This example itself has a deterministic sharp threshold.

approaches.title: Graphical duality and susceptibility
approaches.mechanism: Backward ancestry; Laplace transform of total infection-time volume; killed linear system
approaches.retained_result: Exact representation and independently checked finite identities
approaches.remaining_gap: Uniform pair/joint ancestry control needed for stationary lower-tail concentration is unproved.

approaches.title: Abstract monotonicity obstruction
approaches.mechanism: Monotone Bernoulli family and compactness contradiction
approaches.retained_result: Complete logical counterexample to deriving the conclusion from only endpoints and monotonicity
approaches.remaining_gap: Not realizable as a claimed SIS counterexample; contact-process structure remains essential.
